symptom: Adding the official MiniMax H3 catalog row made three catalog contract tests fail and exposed MiniMax H3 with APIMart-only image-reference modes instead of its official text-to-video-only contract.
direct_cause: The new hailuo-h3 profile lived only in the renderer directory and was absent from the shared source-backed registry; when explicit lookup missed, profileFor fell through to fuzzy modelKey matching and selected APIMart's same-named MiniMax-H3 profile. One APIMart test also counted mappings by modelKey without its vendor owner.
class_root: An explicit catalog archetype identity was not fail-closed at the shared profile resolver, so an omitted registry entry could silently borrow another provider's similarly named wire contract, while one regression assertion contradicted the catalog's vendor-scoped mapping identity.
affected_population: Users enabling the official MiniMax H3 video model after catalog seeding
Any future curated video provider whose remote model name matches another provider while its explicit archetype profile is missing from the shared registry
entry_points: applyBuiltinSeeds creates provider-owned MiniMax and APIMart model and mapping rows
buildVideoModelCandidates resolves seeded catalog rows into GUI and planning capability profiles
selectTaskMapping resolves a runnable mapping by vendor, task kind, and model key
internal_only_reason: MiniMax's official API documentation determines its endpoint and payload, but the failing invariant is Nomi's internal ownership and resolver behavior: explicit archetype ids and mapping identities must remain provider-scoped. Repository types, seed reconciliation, and shared registry code are the authority for that invariant.
invariants: A curated video's explicit archetypeId resolves only to that exact shared profile; if the profile is absent, resolution returns a conservative unknown profile and never guesses by model name.
Source-backed video profiles are owned in electron/shared/videoCapabilities and renderer modules only re-export them.
Mapping identity is the tuple vendorKey, taskKind, and optional modelKey, so equal remote model names in different vendors remain independent.
The official MiniMax H3 model key remains the API enum MiniMax-H3 and its request body derives the model field from the selected catalog row.
generality_proof: All GUI, MCP planning, and curated video capability projections converge on buildVideoModelCandidates and profileFor. Making explicit ids authoritative prevents every provider and future model-name collision from crossing profile ownership. Seed and runtime mapping selection already include vendorKey; correcting the APIMart class assertion verifies the same tuple rather than manufacturing global model-name uniqueness.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Resolve explicit source-backed archetype identities exactly and fail closed to a conservative catalog profile when the registry entry is missing.
Persist and reconcile curated mappings using the provider-scoped vendorKey, taskKind, and modelKey identity tuple.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The row declares archetypeId hailuo-h3 and reaches profileFor through the shared seeded catalog projection; its mapping remains owned by vendor minimax.
The same remote model name declares archetypeId minimax-h3-apimart and is resolved exactly while its mappings remain owned by vendor apimart.
The changed boundary returns unknownVideoArchetype before fuzzy identifier matching whenever an explicit archetypeId is not registered.

recurrence.reason: Every new curated provider can reuse a vendor model enum already present elsewhere or omit one registry import, so name-based fallback could otherwise reproduce the same cross-provider capability leak.
same_class_scan: Searched all curated catalog modelKey declarations and found MiniMax-H3 in both electron/catalog/apimartVideos.ts and electron/catalog/minimaxVideos.ts.
Traced all mapping selectors and seed reconciliation to vendor-scoped identity in electron/catalog/types.ts and electron/catalog/seedBuiltins.ts.
Checked renderer compatibility modules and confirmed source-backed profiles are re-exported from electron/shared/videoCapabilities across existing providers.

prevention.invariant: An explicit archetypeId either resolves exactly in the source-backed registry or produces a conservative unknown profile; fuzzy identifier matching is allowed only for rows without an explicit identity.
prevention.failure_mode: A missing registration exposes only generic text and single-image shapes and fails the curated exact-profile contract test instead of silently advertising another provider's unsupported modes.
prevention.strategy: Move the MiniMax profile into the shared owner, register it once, and stop explicit identities before the fuzzy name-matching path for every caller.

legacy_paths.rationale: The renderer-owned full profile definition is replaced by a compatibility re-export from the shared Electron owner; there is no second callable or editable profile definition.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The defect is in repository-owned catalog identity and profile resolution; no third-party package or runtime version controls the invariant.

migration: No persisted schema migration is required. Built-in seed reconciliation keeps the existing provider-owned MiniMax row and mapping ids, while source-backed profile ownership changes only code lookup. Installations without the new seed remain unchanged; installations receiving it resolve the exact shared hailuo-h3 profile.
residual_risks: The final paid H3 generation still requires a user-supplied key in safeStorage and provider-side quota; repository tests and earlier curl evidence cannot prove the current account state.
Fuzzy matching remains available for catalog rows that intentionally omit archetypeId; those rows stay conservative unless their identifier match is source-backed.
